name: Animated GD
description: Animated portals, orbs and pads, plus flashy gamemode transitions.

animate-portals.name: Animate portals
animate-portals.description: Swirling vortex sparks, ripples and a breathing glow on every portal (gamemode, gravity, size, mirror, dual, speed...).

animate-orbs.name: Animate orbs
animate-orbs.description: Pulsing halo, spinning dashed ring and orbiting sparks on orbs, plus a burst when you hit one.

animate-pads.name: Animate pads
animate-pads.description: Glow and rising energy particles on pads, plus a jet burst when you hit one.

squash-objects.name: Bounce orbs & pads on hit
squash-objects.description: Orbs punch and pads squash-and-stretch when activated. Purely visual.

mode-transitions.name: Gamemode transitions
mode-transitions.description: Shockwave, implode/explode particles and a portal flare whenever you change gamemode, gravity or size.

player-pop.name: Player morph pop
player-pop.description: The player icon morphs in with an elastic pop when changing gamemode.

screen-flash.name: Screen flash
screen-flash.description: Tinted screen flash in the new gamemode's color.

show-mode-name.name: Show gamemode name
show-mode-name.description: Pop up the name of the new gamemode (SHIP, WAVE...) next to the player.
